external_primary_basis: Kubernetes ValidatingAdmissionPolicy v1/stable exposes admission request variables including request.name separately from the mutable admitted object
Kubernetes StatefulSet Pod identity uses the StatefulSet name plus ordinal; for canonical StatefulSet clayverse with replicas=1 the Pod request name is clayverse-0

adversarial_review.counter_reality: On CREATE, oldObject is null. If a mutating admission component rewrites both app=clayverse and the clayverse container name before validation, a policy based only on current/previous Pod-object markers can stop recognizing the canonical request and admit a RuntimeClass or Kata-annotation mutation.
adversarial_review.repair: requestClayVerse is derived from AdmissionRequest request.name == clayverse-0, independently of current Pod labels/containers. That request anchor participates in both RuntimeClass and io.katacontainers.* validations, and the admitted object name must remain equal to request.name.
adversarial_review.remaining_uncertainty: The new CEL/YAML has not yet been compiled or evaluated by the selected Kubernetes API server. Exact API support, admission ordering/effective mutation behavior, installed binding presence, and the final post-mutation Pod identity/annotations remain runtime gates.
